name: memory-update-dog-roster
description: Memory-update-verification scenario (#79 Phase D / #33 Feature 30 baseline). Establishes a fact ('3 dogs'), references it, updates it ('4 dogs'), then asks for recall. Tests whether the runtime's IMemoryMergePolicy correctly surfaces the UPDATED count vs the stale one. At baseline (pre-Feature-30 supersession), the expected behavior is partial: merging may consolidate but supersession-on-contradiction is the missing piece — turn 5's reply may surface 3, 4, or both numbers.
